programs.title: One Way Mirror
programs.desc: A confession to a lesser crime is still a false confession; when Nick Nehring admits to gunning down a man, claims of self-defense set him up for a shorter sentence; getting the true story could mean the difference of year.

programs.title: The Last Thing She Said
programs.desc: A young woman befriends an elderly cleaning lady who works in her corporate office. However, their relationship soon turns uneasy, then dangerous, when she rejects a date request from the woman's awkward, middle-aged son.

programs.title: This Time Next Year
programs.desc: Minnie and Quinn are born on the same day, one minute apart. Their lives may begin together, but their worlds couldn't be more different. Years later they find themselves together again. Maybe it's time to take a chance on love.

programs.title: Sometimes I Think About Dying
programs.desc: A lonely and socially awkward woman tries to make a connection with a friendly new co-worker who takes her out on a date.

programs.title: The Hands That Feed Us
programs.desc: Exploring the challenges of making a living as a modern Canadian farmer; how they sell their food and how little control they have over the process and price; from small scale to massive debt; from farmer's markets to supply chain.

programs.title: Propaganda: The Art of Selling Lies
programs.desc: An exploration of the means and methods of propagandist persuasion.
